posts.title: Managed storage copy sample (v0.3.3)
posts.text: First asset uses a relative local path (assets/...) and is copied into managed storage when MANAGE_ASSET_STORAGE is enabled. The second asset is an already-served /assets/... URL and is left untouched.

assets.title: Relative local asset (copied when opt-in is on)
assets.description: Resolved next to feed_posts.json; copied into public/assets/managed when MANAGE_ASSET_STORAGE=true.

assets.title: Already-served URL (left untouched)
assets.description: Begins with /assets/, so it is never copied or rewritten regardless of the toggle.
